messages:
Maya (AE): Petrum legal asked for compliance artifacts to move the SOW: SOC2 Type II summary, ISO scope page, pen-test attestation letter, and a short note about Dedicated pricing impact. Can someone take point?
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I can own the technical bundle. Clarify: redacted SOC2 OK or do they want full report?
Maya (AE): They said "procurement needs something official" but they didn't ask for raw findings. I think redacted is fine for now.
Rina (InfoSec): Redacted SOC2 summary + ISO scope doc are standard. For pen-test, we provide an attestation letter signed by our security vendor with scope and date range. We won't include raw vulnerability data without an NDA.
Tasha (Legal): I'll prepare the pen-test attestation wording. Keep it limited: statement of scope, date, and verification that tests were performed on production-facing endpoints. No details about specific vulnerabilities.
EvidenceBot: New evidence request logged: EB-2024-1175. Storage: s3://redwood-evidence/handovers/EB-2024-1175/
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Plan: assemble `SOC2-summary.pdf`, `ISO-scope.pdf`, `pen-test-attestation.pdf`, and `pricing-note.txt`. I'll put a staging README that lists test creds and notes that KMS keys are not shared.
Maya (AE): Customer wants the bundle within 48 hours to keep the POC start. Can we do that?
Rina (InfoSec): We can if Legal signs the attestation today. Also confirm whether Petrum expects evidence of scanning cadence (they sometimes ask). We can include last external scan date and a redacted summary.
Tasha (Legal): I'll have a draft in 3 hours. Also advise Maya to check DocuSign status — if NDA isn't executed, we'll watermark PDFs and restrict detail.
Maya (AE): DocuSign shows NDA sent but unsigned. I'll nudge them now.
EvidenceBot: Last external scan: 2024-10-31. Scan summary located at s3://redwood-evidence/scans/2024-10-31-external-summary.pdf
Ethan (Solutions Eng): For SFTP drop use `sftp.redwood-infra.com:/incoming/petrum-2411259000`. Example: `put EB-2024-1175.tar.gz`
Maya (AE): Also flag: Petrum asked whether using Dedicated capacity for the POC changes SLA or pricing materially. High-level answer only please.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I'll include a line: "Estimated POC dedicated pricing: $600/day (depends on GPU type & hours); SLA similar but final terms in contract." Keep it approximate.
Rina (InfoSec): If they press for raw findings we escalate to Compliance, which will delay >10 business days.
Tasha (Legal): Draft uploaded: drive:/Legal/PenTests/Petrum_attestation_v1.docx. I will sign after Rina confirms.
Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll update Petrum: expect redacted SOC2 + ISO scope + signed pen-test attestation + pricing note within 48-72h depending on NDA. Will follow up once NDA status updates. :thumbsup: 
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Copy. I'll assemble once Tasha flags final.
EvidenceBot: EB-2024-1175 assigned to Ethan. Status: open.
